analyst_view.overall: Atletico Madrid (23rd, 4 points) and Viking (22nd, 4 points) sit one place apart and both need points to stay in the play-off places, in the clubs' first meeting. Atletico beat Getafe 3-0 on Sunday; Lookman (knee) and Cuti Romero (muscle) are out and counted by the numbers, while Marc Pubill (ankle) is also out according to Sports Mole, BeSoccer and UEFA but is no longer on the numbers' list; Simeone spoke of managing efforts with games every three days, and previews expect Le Normand and Hancko at centre-back with Julian Alvarez up front. Viking, the Norwegian champions, are without Baertelsen, Bjorshol, D'Agostino and Roseth (all counted). New since this morning: an illness has hit the squad, left-back Kristoffer Haugen stayed in Norway sick, and top scorer Peter Christiansen did not fly with the team after a stomach bug and was travelling alone on Tuesday, so he may play but not at full strength (Tipsbladet, Tufutbolero). Belgian referee Erik Lambrechts (2.9 cards a game) is already counted.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.8 goals, 2.6 of them Atletico's, and already take Lookman and Romero off Atletico (about -2% each). They don't see two missing defenders: Viking's left-back Haugen is ill and stayed home, and Atletico's Pubill is out, which helps both attacks; Christiansen arriving late after a stomach bug pulls the other way for Viking, so I lean only slightly higher, about 3.9 (3.8 x 1.03).

corners.text: The numbers expect 11.8 corners, about 8 of them Atletico's, who should have most of the ball at home. Viking's busy recent corner count already adds about 3% to their side and Atletico's quieter run takes 1.5% off theirs; Grimaldo and Giuliano Simeone on the flanks fit that picture, and a makeshift Viking left side changes where the attacks come from more than how many corners follow, so I stay at about 12.

cards.text: The numbers expect 2.9 cards, already cut about 17% for referee Erik Lambrechts, who shows 2.9 a game, and a little for both sides' recent counts. There is no rivalry and Viking are an open, attacking side rather than a cynical one; an ill, rotated defence could foul more, but that is a hunch, so I stay at 2.9.

shots.text: The numbers say 31.1 shots, 21 of them Atletico's, and already add about 14% to Viking's side for their recent shooting against a leaky Atletico. Atletico at home with Alvarez, Baena and Sorloth or Lee Kang-in should shoot plenty, which is the usual picture, and Christiansen's illness may trim Viking's few shots a little, but not enough to move, so I stay at about 31.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 11 shots on target and already take about 2% off Atletico for their accuracy lately. Lookman and Romero are counted, the rest of Atletico's front line is fit, and Viking's finishing depends on whether Christiansen is sharp after his illness, which could go either way, so I stay at 11.
